Package neqsim.process.fielddevelopment.reservoir

Class TubingVlpProvider

java.lang.Object
neqsim.process.fielddevelopment.reservoir.TubingVlpProvider
All Implemented Interfaces:
VlpProvider
public class TubingVlpProvider extends Object implements VlpProvider
Vertical lift performance of a (deviated) well from TubingPerformance.

For every table coordinate the well stream is created by a VfpFluidFactory, set to the bottomhole temperature, and the bottomhole pressure that gives the requested wellhead pressure is solved with TubingPerformance.calculateInletPressureForOutlet(SystemInterface, double, double). The tubing is described by a survey (measured depth, true vertical depth and inner diameter per interval) so that inclination and diameter change along the well without hand-written chains of instances.

The Gray correlation is the default because Beggs-Brill over-predicts the pressure drop of lean gas wells. Each evaluation costs one fluid flash per integration segment and iteration, so keep setNumberOfSegments(int) small (3 to 10 per well is usually enough for smooth gas wells) and verify the table against a finer direct run. Instances are not thread-safe.

1.0

      public TubingVlpProvider(VfpFluidFactory fluidFactory, double[] md, double[] tvd, double[] innerDiameter)
      Creates a provider for a well described by a survey.
      Parameters:
      fluidFactory - creates the well stream for each coordinate
      md - measured depths of the survey stations in m, increasing from the wellhead
      tvd - true vertical depths of the stations in m
      innerDiameter - inner diameter in m for each interval between stations (md.length - 1 values)
      Throws:
      IllegalArgumentException - if the survey is inconsistent

    • bottomHolePressure

      public double bottomHolePressure(double rate, double outletPressure, double waterRatio, double gasRatio, double alq)
      Calculates the flowing pressure at the table datum for one table coordinate.
      Specified by:
      bottomHolePressure in interface VlpProvider
      Parameters:
      rate - surface rate in Sm3/day of the table rate basis
      outletPressure - pressure at the outlet node (THP axis value) in bara
      waterRatio - water ratio in the unit of the selected water ratio type (0 when the table has no such axis)
      gasRatio - gas ratio in the unit of the selected gas ratio type (0 when the table has no such axis)
      alq - artificial lift quantity (gas lift rate in Sm3/day, 0 when not used)
      Returns:
      flowing pressure at datum in bara; NaN or an exception marks the point as infeasible
